Entries.GoldenEgg_Description: Qobig‘i sof oltindan bo‘lgan juda noyob va o‘ziga xos tuxum.
Entries.GoldenMask_Description: Ehtimol, qadimiy sehrli marosimda ishlatilgan vahimali oltin niqob. Peshonasidagi uyaga yirik siyohrang gavhar o‘rnatilgan.
Entries.GoldenPumpkin_Description: U qimmatli, ammo boshqa maqsadga yaramaydi.
Entries.GoldenRelic_Description: Old tomoniga ierogliflar va rasmlar tushirilgan oltin lavha.
Entries.GoldenWalnut_Description: Zanjabil oroli to‘tiqushlari uchun bu yong‘oq eng tansiq ne’matdir.
Entries.GoldOre_Description: Quymalarga eritish mumkin bo‘lgan qimmatbaho ruda.
Entries.GoldStone_Description: Oltin rudasi olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
Entries.Granite_Description: Qurilishda keng ishlatiladigan mayda dog‘li mineral.
Entries.GrapeStarter_Description: Kuzda eking. O‘sishiga 10 kun ketadi, keyin esa hosil berishda davom etadi. Panjarada o‘sadi.
Entries.GrassBook_Description: Endi o‘tlar va ekinlar orasidan ancha tezroq yugurasiz.
Entries.GrassStarter_Description: Yangi o‘t maydonini boshlash uchun buni fermangizga joylashtiring.
Entries.GravelPath_Description: Yo‘lak yaratish yoki polingizni bezash uchun yerga joylashtiring.
Entries.GreenBean_Description: Suvli, kichkina loviya; tishlaganda yoqimli qarsillaydi.
Entries.GreenRainWeeds_Description: Ichidan tola yoki aralash urug‘lar chiqishi mumkin.
Entries.GreenTea_Description: Yengil ishlov berilgan choy barglaridan tayyorlangan yoqimli, tetiklantiruvchi ichimlik.
Entries.Hardwood_Description: O‘ta mustahkam va chiroyli yog‘ochning o‘ziga xos turi.
Entries.Hay_Description: Hayvonlarga yem sifatida beriladigan quritilgan o‘t.
Entries.Hedge_Description: To‘siq vazifasini bajaradigan shakl berilgan buta.
Entries.Hematite_Description: Qiziqarli magnit xususiyatlarga ega temir asosli mineral.
